公司简介 Company Profile

关于我们 About Us

金华莱盟纺织品有限公司是一家专注于针织与织造纺织品进出口的外贸企业，依托中国主要纺织产业带的成熟供应链，为全球采购商提供稳定、优质、高效的面料供应服务。 Jinhua Laimeng Textile Factory is an import & export company specializing in knitted and woven textiles. Backed by mature supply chains across China’s major textile hubs, we deliver stable, quality-assured fabrics to buyers worldwide.

我们长期深耕针织、梭织两大品类，熟悉国际市场的品质标准与合规要求，能够快速响应打样、翻单与大货交付需求，成为客户长期信赖的供应链伙伴。 Focusing on knitted and woven fabrics, we understand international quality standards and compliance requirements, responding quickly to sampling, re-orders and bulk production — a supply chain partner you can rely on for the long term.

核心优势 Why Choose Us

源头供应链 Source Supply Chain

直连产业带工厂，货源稳定、价格有竞争力。 Direct access to mill clusters — stable supply at competitive prices.

品质管控 Quality Control

从坯布到成品出运的全流程检验与把控。 Full-process inspection from greige fabric to shipment.

贸易专业度 Trade Expertise

熟悉国际标准、单证与合规要求，沟通顺畅。 Fluent in international standards, documentation and compliance.

高效交付 Efficient Delivery

起订量灵活，按时交货，物流方案成熟。 Flexible MOQ, on-time shipment and mature logistics.

产品中心 Products

聚焦针织与织造两大品类，常年供应主流规格面料；以下为代表产品，更多品类欢迎垂询。 Focused on two core categories — knitted and woven — with mainstream specifications in regular supply. Representative products below; more available on request.

针织纺织品 Knitted Textiles

手感柔软、弹性良好，广泛用于 T 恤、运动服与内衣。 Soft hand-feel with natural stretch — widely used for T-shirts, activewear and underwear.

2 图 2 Photos 100–220 g/m²

汗布 Single Jersey

透气亲肤，T 恤与居家服经典面料。 Breathable & skin-friendly, a classic for T-shirts and loungewear.

2 图 2 Photos 150–300 g/m²

罗纹 Rib Fabric

弹性足、回弹好，用于领口袖口与修身款。 High stretch & recovery, for collars, cuffs and fitted styles.

2 图 2 Photos 200–350 g/m²

毛圈布 French Terry

柔软吸汗，卫衣帽衫常用面料。 Soft and absorbent, the go-to fabric for hoodies and sweatshirts.

织造纺织品 Woven Textiles

结构挺括、结实耐久，适用于衬衫、工装与家纺。 Crisp, structured and durable — for shirts, workwear and home textiles.

2 图 2 Photos 100–160 g/m²

府绸 Poplin

细洁平滑、手感爽挺，经典衬衫面料。 Fine, smooth and crisp — a classic shirting fabric.

2 图 2 Photos 200–350 g/m²

纱卡 / 斜纹 Twill / Drill

结实耐磨，工装裤装首选面料。 Strong and abrasion-resistant, first choice for workwear and trousers.

2 图 2 Photos 150–300 g/m²

牛津布 Oxford

挺括耐用，箱包、休闲服饰与家纺适用。 Sturdy and durable, for bags, casual wear and home textiles.
